item.title: PHP Techniques for Extracting Text Between Two Strings
item.description:
“PHP Techniques for Extracting Text Between Two Strings”

How can a developer reliably extract a substring that sits strictly between two known delimiter strings in PHP, considering various scenarios like multiple occurrences, case sensitivity, and UTF-8 characters? A variety of functional approaches exist, ranging from basic string positioning functions to advanced regular expressions.

Below are several distinct, tested solutions for achieving this common text parsing requirement.

Solution 1: Using strpos and substr (Initial Approach)

One straightforward method involves calculating the exact position of the start and end markers and then extracting the segment. This implementation prepends a space to the string to handle edge cases where the start marker is at index zero.
